any finite randomized family of nontrivial K-approval rules.

source_definition1_design_invariance.statement: Source Definition 1: asymptotic design invariance. A reasonable rule family is design-invariant for a goal when all reasonable rules induce the same limiting outcome.

source_definition3_rate_optimality.statement: Source Definition 3: rate optimality. Within a feasible design class, a rule is rate-optimal when it maximizes the finite learning rate.
